response.sql: SELECT AVG(rebrate / feerate) AS average_rebate_to_fee_ratio, COUNT(*) AS fee_record_count FROM fees WHERE feerate >= 0.0009;

assumptions.assumption: The count includes every fee record meeting the fee-rate threshold, including records with a missing rebate rate. AVG ignores those missing rebate rates.

alternatives.interpretation: Count only fee records that contribute a nonmissing ratio to the average.
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(rebrate / feerate) AS average_rebate_to_fee_ratio, COUNT(rebrate) AS fee_record_count FROM fees WHERE feerate >= 0.0009;
